title: Lure the Blockader
setup: Your pawn on e7 wants the eighth rank, and only the rook on a8 stands guard over it.
hint: The rook is the whole defense. Find the square where taking it is the only move Black has left.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} leaves Black one legal move, {{Rxd8}} — and the rook has been dragged onto the square your pawn attacks. {{exd8=Q#}} promotes with mate. A rook is cheap when a pawn becomes a queen.
